summary: An established Fa Ham noodle shop known for rich northern-style khao soi, with other northern dishes for a fuller shared meal. It sits beside Wat Fa Ham, outside the Old City core, so plan it as a short ride rather than a casual central-city walk.
whyGo: Taste Chiang Mai khao soi with chicken, beef and other meat choices reported by visitors.
Order northern accompaniments such as nam ngiao, sai ua or khanom jeen if available that day.
Compare two Fa Ham old-school shops: Samer Jai and Lamduan are close to one another.
bestFor: Groups who want to share several northern dishes
skipIf: You need dinner or a central Old City location
You require guaranteed vegetarian, halal, gluten-free or allergy-safe preparation without advance confirmation
duration: Allow 30–60 minutes for the meal and possible lunch crowding; this is a planning estimate.
cost: A June 2026 local guide reports khao soi from about THB 40 per bowl. Budget roughly THB 100–200 per person for a bowl, drink or shared side; current itemized menu prices were not confirmed.
hours: Listings show approximately 08:00–17:00, with a recent Wongnai page showing service until 17:00. Weekly closing days and holiday hours were not conclusively verified; check on the day.
bestTime: Aim for mid-morning or before noon to avoid the reported lunchtime rush and allow time before closing.
gettingThere: The restaurant is on Charoen Rat Road beside Wat Fa Ham, in Fa Ham on the east side of the Ping River. From the Old City, use a metered taxi or ride-hailing car, or negotiate a songthaew; show the driver the restaurant name and Wat Fa Ham pin. Wongnai reviewers report parking at the temple, but availability is not assured.
booking: Treat it as a walk-in noodle shop. No reliable official reservation channel was found; check current listing or call locally if travelling with a large group.
accessibility: The restaurant is described by visitors as spacious, but step-free entry, accessible toilets and wheelchair clearance are unverified. Contact the venue if these are essential.
practicalTips: Start with chicken or beef khao soi; recent visitor reports also mention pork and other northern dishes, but menus can vary.
Taste the curry first, then adjust with lime, shallot, pickled greens and chilli.
Carry cash as a fallback; payment methods were not verified.
Egg noodles contain wheat and commonly egg; ask about broth, curry paste, fish sauce and shared cooking surfaces for dietary needs. A meat-free topping does not make the dish vegetarian.
decemberNotes: This is an everyday daytime meal, not a seasonal event. December 2026 holiday opening has not been announced in the sources checked; reconfirm around Christmas and New Year and keep a nearby alternative in mind.
uncertainties: Opening days and holiday schedule need direct confirmation.
The THB 40 starting price is a guide estimate, not a verified current menu price.
No official contact details, booking policy, payment information, dietary accommodation or accessibility specification were established.
